tasks.title: Implement ngv2/contracts.py artifact dataclasses (Finding / PoC / LiveTestReport)
acceptance_criteria: NEW file ngv2/contracts.py is created; pure, deterministic, stdlib-only importing ONLY from dataclasses and typing.
Module exposes SEVERITIES = ('low','medium','high','critical') and VERDICTS = ('confirmed','refuted','error','inconclusive') as module-level tuples.
Finding is a @dataclass with fields in exact order: id:str, target:str, category:str, severity:str, title:str, description:str, evidence:list = field(default_factory=list).
PoC is a @dataclass with fields: finding_id:str, language:str, code:str, entrypoint:str.
LiveTestReport is a @dataclass with fields: poc_finding_id:str, verdict:str, exit_code (int or None), stdout:str, stderr:str, duration_ms:int.
Each class exposes to_dict() -> dict keyed EXACTLY by its field names, classmethod from_dict(d) reconstructing an equal instance, and validate() -> None.
Finding.from_dict defaults evidence to [] when the key is absent; from_dict(to_dict(x)) == x for all three classes via default __eq__.
Finding.validate raises ValueError if severity not in SEVERITIES or if any of id/target/category/title is not a non-empty str.
PoC.validate raises ValueError if any of the four fields is not a non-empty str.
LiveTestReport.validate raises ValueError if verdict not in VERDICTS, or duration_ms < 0, or poc_finding_id is not a non-empty str (exit_code may be int or None).
No eval/exec/__import__, no I/O, file access, network, globals, or randomness; no fields/methods/symbols beyond those specified; no field name or order changes.

spec.objective: Create the L0 artifact contract module ngv2/contracts.py defining the Finding, PoC, and LiveTestReport dataclasses plus the SEVERITIES and VERDICTS constants, each with deterministic to_dict/from_dict round-tripping and validate() rules, satisfying the already-committed oracle tests/test_contracts.py.
functional_requirements: Define module constants SEVERITIES = ('low','medium','high','critical') and VERDICTS = ('confirmed','refuted','error','inconclusive') as tuples.
Define @dataclass Finding with fields in order id:str, target:str, category:str, severity:str, title:str, description:str, evidence:list=field(default_factory=list), using default __eq__.
Define @dataclass PoC with fields finding_id:str, language:str, code:str, entrypoint:str, using default __eq__.
Define @dataclass LiveTestReport with fields poc_finding_id:str, verdict:str, exit_code (int or None), stdout:str, stderr:str, duration_ms:int, using default __eq__.
Each class implements to_dict() -> dict keyed exactly by its field names with no extra keys.
Each class implements classmethod from_dict(d) reconstructing an instance equal to the original under default __eq__, with Finding.from_dict defaulting evidence to [] when the key is absent.
Finding.validate() raises ValueError when severity not in SEVERITIES or when any of id/target/category/title is not a non-empty str; otherwise returns None.
PoC.validate() raises ValueError when any of finding_id/language/code/entrypoint is not a non-empty str; otherwise returns None.
LiveTestReport.validate() raises ValueError when verdict not in VERDICTS, or duration_ms < 0, or poc_finding_id is not a non-empty str (exit_code may be int or None); otherwise returns None.
spec.interfaces: SEVERITIES = ('low','medium','high','critical'); VERDICTS = ('confirmed','refuted','error','inconclusive'); @dataclass Finding(id:str, target:str, category:str, severity:str, title:str, description:str, evidence:list=field(default_factory=list)) with to_dict()->dict, classmethod from_dict(d)->Finding, validate()->None; @dataclass PoC(finding_id:str, language:str, code:str, entrypoint:str) with to_dict()->dict, classmethod from_dict(d)->PoC, validate()->None; @dataclass LiveTestReport(poc_finding_id:str, verdict:str, exit_code, stdout:str, stderr:str, duration_ms:int) with to_dict()->dict, classmethod from_dict(d)->LiveTestReport, validate()->None.
edge_cases: Finding.from_dict called with a dict lacking the 'evidence' key must produce a Finding with evidence == [].
Round-trip from_dict(to_dict(x)) == x must hold including when evidence is a populated list.
validate() must treat empty strings and non-str values (e.g. None, ints) as invalid for the non-empty str checks.
LiveTestReport.exit_code may legitimately be None or an int and validate() must accept both.
LiveTestReport.validate() must reject negative duration_ms (boundary: 0 is valid, -1 is invalid).
to_dict() must contain exactly the declared field names as keys and no others.
non_goals: Do NOT author, create, or modify any test file; tests/test_contracts.py is already committed.
Do NOT use eval, exec, or __import__.
Do NOT add fields, methods, or symbols beyond those specified, and do NOT change field names or order.
Do NOT add I/O, file access, network, globals, or randomness; import only from dataclasses/typing.
Do NOT define the state machine or detonation chamber here, and do NOT collapse modules.
spec.implementation_notes: Single new file ngv2/contracts.py. Use dataclasses.dataclass, dataclasses.field, and dataclasses.fields/asdict as helpers if desired (still stdlib-only). Implement to_dict() by enumerating the dataclass field names (e.g. {f.name: getattr(self, f.name) for f in fields(self)}). Implement from_dict() as a classmethod selecting only known keys; for Finding default evidence to [] when absent. Rely on default dataclass __eq__ so round-trip equality holds. validate() should perform explicit isinstance(..., str) and truthiness checks for non-empty-str rules and membership checks against SEVERITIES/VERDICTS. Keep the module free of side effects at import time.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Valid and invalid instances of each dataclass: Findings with/without evidence and with invalid severity or empty/non-str id/target/category/title; PoCs with empty/non-str fields; LiveTestReports with valid/invalid verdict, negative duration_ms, and exit_code as int and None. The authoritative tests are the already-committed tests/test_contracts.py; no new test data files are created.

token_budget_ratio.note: IMPL-ONLY task: tests/test_contracts.py is already committed, so no test authoring is performed; the test_tokens figure reflects the committed oracle that gates this task rather than new test work.
